name: Cannabinoid
summary: Cannabinoid is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Most are metabolized in the liver by cytochrome P450 enzymes, mainly CYP 2C9. Inhibiting CYP 2C9 can extend intoxication. Δ9-THC is metabolized to 11-hydroxy-Δ9-THC and then 9-carboxy-THC, detectable in the body for weeks due to their lipophilic nature and storage in fat. The entourage effect suggests that terpenes modulate cannabinoid effects.

uses.text: Medical uses of cannabinoids include the treatment of nausea due to chemotherapy, spasticity, and possibly neuropathic pain. Common side effects include dizziness, sedation, confusion, dissociation, and "feeling high".

summaryZh: 大麻素（英語：Cannabinoids），又稱大麻類物質，是從大麻裡發現的一組萜酚類化合物，也自然地存在於動物神經和免疫系統裡。大麻素的外延包括結構上與四氫大麻酚相關或與大麻素受體結合的一組物質。

sideEffects.en: Effects vary widely across the group. Plant cannabinoids such as THC can cause dizziness, sleepiness, confusion, anxiety and paranoia. Synthetic cannabinoids can be far stronger and have caused seizures, psychosis, kidney injury and deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 這一大類物質的作用差異很大。THC 等植物大麻素可能造成頭暈、嗜睡、意識混亂、焦慮與妄想。合成大麻素的作用可能強得多，並曾導致癲癇發作、精神病症狀、腎臟損傷與死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 这一大类物质的作用差异很大。THC 等植物大麻素可能造成头晕、嗜睡、意识混乱、焦虑与妄想。合成大麻素的作用可能强得多，并曾导致癫痫发作、精神病症状、肾脏损伤与死亡。

fact.en: The body makes its own cannabinoids. The first one found, anandamide, was identified in 1992 and named after the Sanskrit word "ananda", meaning bliss.
fact.zh: 人體會自行製造大麻素。第一個被發現的是在 1992 年鑑定出的花生四烯乙醇胺（anandamide），名稱取自梵文「ananda」，意思是極樂。
fact.zhHans: 人体会自行制造大麻素。第一个被发现的是在 1992 年鉴定出的花生四烯乙醇胺（anandamide），名称取自梵文「ananda」，意思是极乐。
